risk_reasons: The campaign sends bounded concurrent authenticated traffic to shared staging and could reproduce the permanent postgres.js/Supavisor ClientRead wedge until the affected Vercel isolate is reaped.
The AAL2 admin route is a cross-tenant sensitive read surface, and database observations must exclude query text, response bodies, cookies, and credentials.
The result governs a production database-capacity decision under the shared 57-usable-backend and approximately 200-client Supavisor ceilings.
goal: Produce a reproducible evidence-backed #773 capacity decision by measuring complete authenticated owner-dashboard and AAL2-admin responses under overlapping Vercel staging load, correlating them with backend connection pressure, and selecting exactly one next treatment without deploying it.
non_goals: Change postgres.js client options, DB_POOL_MAX, DB_READ_POOL_MAX, route-to-client wiring, Supabase compute, or any remote environment variable in this campaign.
Deploy a candidate treatment to staging or production, merge a pull request, or close issue 773 before the selected treatment is implemented and validated in its own guarded feature run.
Run the shared-staging outbox injection arms from Part B of docs/runbooks/pool-wedge-burst-drill.md; this campaign exercises the Vercel request surface only.
Create or mutate owners, admins, businesses, reviews, flags, outbox rows, schemas, migrations, or other durable staging fixtures.
Treat absence of a reproduced wedge as proof that cross-request pool sharing or the residual wedge class does not exist.
user_visible_behavior: No customer-facing behavior changes in this investigation.

Maintainers receive a current pre-treatment latency distribution, deployment identity, Vercel invocation health, backend-session headroom, and a single documented treatment choice with explicit rejection reasons for the alternatives.
invariants: Only existing authenticated Chrome sessions are used; cookies, tokens, response bodies, and credentials are never read, exported, logged, or written to evidence.
Every measured request uses cache no-store, a 15-second deadline, and timing through completed response.text(), with one warm-up excluded from recorded samples.
Owner and AAL2-admin measurements retain the exact routes, roles, concurrency, sample counts, deadline, cache posture, and full-body completion contract documented in the #773 runbook.
Database observations use a separate direct read-only connection, record counts and state/wait-event aggregates without query text, and never terminate a backend on shared staging.
The campaign aborts on any timeout, non-2xx response, corroborated growing ClientRead wedge, staging health degradation, or backend-session pressure at or above 80 percent of the 57-usable ceiling.

No treatment is selected unless the evidence explicitly accounts for ADR 0009's per-isolate write-plus-read client budget, the existing Vercel-side drill, and the compound worker-plus-Vercel residual.
edge_cases: If the Codex Chrome Extension or native host is unavailable, the campaign stops before load generation rather than substituting unauthenticated requests or exporting cookies.
If either owner or AAL2 session is expired, the affected lane remains unproven and no capacity decision is finalized.

If low staging traffic or Fluid scheduling spreads requests across isolates, the result is recorded as non-reproduction and interpreted with Vercel Start Type plus backend-session evidence rather than as a cure.
If the current staging deployment differs during the measurement window, all samples from the mixed window are discarded and rerun against one deployment ID.
If a route returns a streamed 200 whose body misses the deadline, it is counted as a timeout/failure even though headers succeeded.
If any preflight check reveals existing ClientRead wedges or degraded staging health, the run aborts without adding load.

test_seams: Authenticated page-context fetch from the existing owner session to GET /api/dashboard.
Authenticated page-context fetch from the existing AAL2 admin session to GET /api/admin/flagged?limit=20&offset=0.
Vercel staging deployment identity and invocation telemetry for the exact UTC measurement window.
Read-only pg_stat_activity state and wait-event aggregates sampled through a separate direct staging connection.
rollback_plan: No product or remote configuration is changed. Stop load immediately at an abort threshold, retain the complete evidence and deviation record, allow affected Vercel isolates to reap naturally, and verify staging returns to its preflight request and pg_stat_activity baseline. Do not terminate shared-staging backends. Any later treatment has its own rollback in its implementation intake.
observability: Per route and concurrency: sample count, HTTP statuses, failures, timeouts, min/p50/p95/max full-body latency, cache posture, auth role, deployment ID, and UTC window.
Vercel telemetry for the exact window: invocation errors, timeouts, Start Type distribution, region, and available latency/resource signals.
Contemporaneous pg_stat_activity aggregates: total, active, idle, idle-in-transaction, ClientRead count and oldest ClientRead age, without query text.

Decision thresholds: zero request failures/timeouts, zero growing ClientRead wedge, and peak backend sessions below 46 of 57 usable; otherwise abort and select a treatment that reduces or queues per-isolate demand.
